      Who Google sends to the site

      Trend

      How much spend goes on people Kukoon already has?

      Northbeam can't prove incrementality; that needs a holdout test. It can show where spend lands on people who already know or buy from Kukoon, which is where non-incremental spend hides.

      Spend by campaign new-customer share

      Spend by campaign % new visits

      Campaigns ranked by spend reaching existing audiences

      Spend on returning customers = spend × returning share of customers. Flags: new visits under 30%, new-customer share under 70%, or recent-repeat customers above 10%.

      What Northbeam can and can't tell you

      • Can: who each campaign's clicks and buyers are (new, returning, recent repeat). That shows where spend is likely to be low-incrementality.
      • Can't: whether those people would have bought anyway. A returning visitor clicking a Shopping ad may have been about to come back through brand search or email.
      • To prove it: run a holdout. Either a Google conversion-lift study or a geo split, for example pausing IE Shopping in half of the Republic for 4 weeks. Compare total orders, not attributed orders.

        UTM campaigns

        Top campaigns by orders within each channel; the rest sit in "(other campaigns)". Google Ads orders carry no utm_campaign (auto-tagging only), so Google can't be split by campaign in Shopify.

        Online Store vs shop (POS) orders by month

        Northbeam takes in web orders only. A POS customer who later buys online is "returning" to Shopify but can be "new" to Northbeam.

        Tracking gaps in Shopify's own attribution

        Orders Shopify couldn't tie to a session or a known source. These hide some Google and Meta orders from the channel view.

          Definitions and data notes

          MetricDefinitionNorthbeam field
          % new visitsVisits from a browser the Northbeam pixel has never seen ÷ all visits.newVisits ÷ visits
          Returning, never boughtVisits from a browser seen before that has never purchased.visitsRtnWithoutPurchase
          Existing customer visitsVisits from someone who has bought from Kukoon before.visitsRtnWithPurchase
          New-customer shareFirst-time customers ÷ (first-time + returning active + returning reactivated). Uses the same denominator everywhere, so shares add to 100%.customersFt ÷ (customersFt + customersRtnActive + customersRtnReactivated)
          Returning, recent (active)Repeat buyers whose previous purchase was inside Northbeam's reactivation window. These are the most likely to have bought without the ad.customersRtnActive
          Returning, lapsed (reactivated)Repeat buyers whose previous purchase was before the reactivation window.customersRtnReactivated
          CAC (New)Spend ÷ first-time customers.spend ÷ customersFt
          Blended CACSpend ÷ all customers (new + returning).
          ROAS / ROAS (New)All revenue ÷ spend; first-order revenue ÷ spend.rev, revFt
          Shopify new / returningShopify's customer flag on each order: returning if the customer had a previous order on the store (any channel, including shops). Channel = last non-direct click, from UTM source/medium and referrer.new_customers, returning_customers WITH LAST_NON_DIRECT_CLICK_ATTRIBUTION
          Shopify new-customer shareNew ÷ (new + returning) customers. Shopify counts customers, so a customer with two orders in a period counts once.Derived
          Spend on returning customersSpend × returning share of customers. An estimate of budget going to people who had already bought.Derived
          • Shopify data: ShopifyQL, sales dataset, last non-direct click, 28 May to 28 Oct 2026, plus monthly history Oct 2023 to Oct 2026 by sales channel. Channel groups (from Shopify's marketing channel and traffic type): google_ads = Google Ads, meta_ads or paid Facebook/Instagram = Meta, klaviyo, affiliates (Awin, deal sites), direct, organic search, onsite/Shopify, AI assistants, others. "No session data" = orders Shopify could not attach to a session.
          • Northbeam comparison settings: clicks-only 1-day, 7-day, 30-day and all-time; last non-direct touch; last touch; first touch. All accrual. Pulled 29 Oct 2026.
          • Attribution: clicks only, 7-day window, accrual accounting, the same settings as the September plan. Customers are fractional because credit is split across touchpoints.
          • Pixel start: Northbeam visit data begins on 28 May 2026. Visitor-type metrics drift as the pixel builds history; compare Google with the site line rather than reading absolute changes.
          • Time grains: daily lines are 7-day rolling sums (all markets only). Weekly runs Monday to Sunday; the part-weeks 28 to 31 May and 26 to 28 Oct are left out. Monthly excludes May (4 days); October is 1 to 28 Oct.
          • Visitor counts: visitor types are evaluated day by day, so existing-customer visits run slightly lower than in Northbeam's monthly UI view (2.9% vs 3.7% for Google in September).
          • Campaign types: Brand = Pure Brand + Brand + Other + Brand Sales (NCA versions included). Shopping NCA = the "| NCA" Shopping campaigns launched 14 Sep. Legacy DI = the previous agency's "DI-" campaigns, off from 8 Jul.
          • Events marked on charts: Ignition Shopping live 25 Jun · Legacy DI off 8 Jul · Declining Discount 4 to 7 Sep · NCA launch 14 Sep · Payday weekend 25 to 28 Sep.
